frame.title: Housing & Frame
frame.description: A brand-neutral 120 × 120 × 25 mm rigid thermoplastic PBT frame with a trumpet-shaped intake bellmouth, exhaust flare, aerodynamic rear stator support struts, and standard 105 mm mounting holes.
frame.function: Maintains a precise 2.5 mm blade-tip clearance across all RPM ranges, minimizes air recirculation losses through the intake flare, and channels airflow smoothly along four aerodynamic rear guide struts.
frame.importance: Frame rigidity prevents structural flexing and harmonic buzzing against the PC chassis, while the intake bellmouth geometry reduces turbulence noise at high intake velocity.
facts: 120 mm is the ubiquitous desktop PC form factor, utilizing standard 105 × 105 mm screw spacing.
The four rear stator struts support the central motor hub; one strut incorporates an integrated wire channel.
Molded directional arrows on the frame exterior indicate airflow direction and impeller rotation.

blades.title: Aerodynamic Impeller
blades.description: A nine-blade rotor array engineered with cambered airfoil cross-sections, spanwise pitch twist, backward-curved sweep, and faired hub root transitions.
blades.function: Draws air axially through the intake bellmouth and accelerates it across the blade surface, converting motor torque into static pressure and linear airflow.
blades.importance: Blade curvature, pitch angle, and tip clearance dictate the fan's pressure-to-airflow curve and acoustic profile: true cambered airfoils move more air with less vortex shedding.
facts: Nine blades balance static pressure for radiators with high volume airflow for chassis ventilation.
Pitch twist (28° at root tapering to 20° at tip) ensures uniform air velocity across the entire blade radius.
Micro-beveled blade tips reduce tip vortex turbulence against the inner frame wall.

hub.title: Rotor Hub & Magnet Bell
hub.description: The central 38 mm cylindrical rotor hub that locks onto the hardened steel motor shaft and houses the internal permanent magnet ring.
hub.function: Houses the multipole permanent magnet ring that reacts with the stator electromagnets, providing continuous rotational torque to the impeller array.
hub.importance: Rotational balance is critical: any mass eccentricity causes bearing wear and audible high-frequency chassis vibration.
facts: A stepped concentric top cap provides aerodynamic air deflection away from the center dead zone.
The internal steel flux ring concentrates magnetic field lines across the stator coil gaps.
Precision dynamic balancing weights are applied inside the hub rim during manufacturing.

bearing.title: Fluid Dynamic Bearing
bearing.description: A cutaway view of a high-precision Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) showing the sintered copper sleeve, spiral herringbone oil grooves, and polished steel shaft.
bearing.function: Pumps lubricating oil through microscopic herringbone grooves when rotating, creating a pressurized hydrodynamic film that completely floats the shaft away from metal-to-metal contact.
bearing.importance: Eliminates surface friction, ensuring nearly silent operation and extending the operational lifespan up to 150,000 hours.
facts: Herringbone grooves self-center the shaft dynamically as rotational speed increases.
Sealed lubricant reservoirs prevent oil evaporation and leakage in horizontal or vertical mounting orientations.
Polished hardened steel shafts are machined to sub-micron surface tolerances.

stator.title: Stator & Copper Coils
stator.description: The stationary four-pole electromagnetic stator core seated on the rear housing, featuring laminated silicon steel pole shoes and high-purity copper winding bobbins.
stator.function: Energizes alternating coil phases via the motor driver IC, generating a rotating magnetic field that pulls the rotor magnet ring around continuously.
stator.importance: Brushless DC operation eliminates mechanical commutators and brushes, generating zero friction, zero electrical sparks, and zero carbon dust.
facts: Laminated silicon steel plates minimize eddy current heat losses in the motor core.
The motor control PCB incorporates a Hall-effect sensor to track rotor position for precise phase timing.
Precision copper wire gauge and turn count determine the motor's operating torque and RPM range.

pwm_cable.title: 4-Pin PWM Cable Harness
pwm_cable.description: A flexible four-conductor ribbon cable harness routed along the frame channel, terminating in a standardized 4-pin female PWM motherboard connector.
pwm_cable.function: Carries +12V DC power, ground, tachometer pulse feedback, and high-frequency PWM speed control signals between the motherboard and fan controller.
pwm_cable.importance: PWM control allows dynamic, stepless RPM adjustment from near-silent low-speed idle up to maximum cooling under heavy thermal loads.
facts: Pin 1 is Ground, Pin 2 is +12V Power, Pin 3 is Tachometer sense, and Pin 4 is PWM speed control.
Polarization ribs and a locking ramp prevent reverse insertion onto motherboard fan headers.
Tachometer signals generate two pulses per revolution for accurate system hardware monitoring.

argb_ring.title: ARGB Diffuser Ring
argb_ring.description: A translucent frosted optical acrylic light ring seated around the intake perimeter, illuminated from beneath by 12 individually addressable RGB LEDs.
argb_ring.function: Diffuses and homogenizes light emitted from discrete SMD LEDs into a continuous, uniform glowing halo without visible hotspots.
argb_ring.importance: Enables synchronized 5V 3-pin digital illumination effects without obstructing aerodynamic intake airflow.
facts: Frosted optical-grade acrylic uses microscopic light-scattering particles for even diffusion.
Each WS2812B/SK6812-compatible SMD LED contains integrated logic for individual color addressing.
The diffuser ring snaps securely into precision retention clips molded into the frame corners.

antivib_pins.title: Silicone Anti-Vibration Pads
antivib_pins.description: Molded elastomeric silicone corner dampening pads seated on the front and rear mounting wings with integrated screw pass-through sleeves.
antivib_pins.function: Acoustically decouples the fan frame from the computer case sheet metal, absorbing high-frequency mechanical vibration before it can resonate.
antivib_pins.importance: Prevents chassis panels from acting as acoustic sounding boards, significantly lowering total system noise levels.
facts: Soft 40-durometer silicone absorbs motor vibration and micro-harmonics across a wide frequency range.
Corner pads feature textured grip ridges that seat firmly against painted case panels.
Compatible with standard self-tapping fan screws and tool-less rubber mounting pull-pins.
